If you are purchasing an avatar through legitimate means, you should be in possession of the files. Should your VRC account get compromised or should the Avatar get removed or deleted in any way, you lose access to the avatar.

You should never share your account login details with anyone and VRC support will never ask for it. Giving it out to anyone can potentially break the ToS and result in account restrictions or loss of access if they alter your account details.

Purchasing VRC content like avatars and worlds from reputable sources should provide you with the files or a unity package for you to use.

Even with a one time token, a malicious actor could upload content that may violate the ToS and result in account restrictions or suspension.

We really needed this ages ago. A one-time access token to upload an avatar on behalf of someone else onto their own account. I'm in the process of helping a friend optimize his avatar to bring it more up to date. He's been afraid to touch it himself out of fear he'll break it and never be able to recover it. So far, I've had to export the project as a backup file and send it to him, then guide him through how to set it up in Unity and upload with a blueprint ID.

Just being able to publish it for him without the hassle of all that would make it a lot easier for people, especially where people want something changed, added or updated and they don't know how themselves.

It's fine to not know how, and it's fine to ask a friend to do a 5 minute fix for you. It's fine that some people can't grasp how Unity works, but they shouldn't feel left out of having their own custom avatar that's their own creation.

details:
IIt would be helpful if VRChat allowed users to generate a one-time avatar upload token that could be shared with an avatar creator. The creator could paste this token into the avatar's blueprint before uploading, and VRChat would automatically assign the uploaded avatar to the intended user's account.

This would eliminate the need for users to share their VRChat login credentials with avatar creators, which is currently one of the most common ways custom avatars are delivered.

For example, I have friends who know little to nothing about avatar creation, and I'd like to make avatars for them. However, because I've had security issues in the past, including account compromises originating through Discord, I'm not comfortable having someone else's login information stored or entered on my PC, even temporarily.

A one-time upload token would improve both security and convenience. The token could be limited to a single upload, expire after a short period of time, and only grant permission to upload an avatar to the user's account. It would not provide access to account settings, personal information, or any other account functions.

This would allow experienced creators to safely build and upload avatars for their friends and clients while preserving account security and reducing the need to share sensitive credentials.
title: Avatar Upload Token
